title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women, from Piedmont and Abruzzo. We keep them in our thoughts with gratitude and respect.

women.name: Caterina Arnò
tribute: Caterina Arnò was 42 years old and came from Turin, in Piedmont. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Vasto Marina
tribute: She was 62 years old and is in our thoughts.
